description: Binding Assay: The competition assay was performed in a 96-well plate (polystyrene*) which binds <2.0% of the total input [3H]-17beta-estradiol and each data point was gathered in triplicate. 100 uG/100 uL of the receptor preparation was aliquoted per well. A saturating dose of 2.5 nM [3H]17beta-estradiol+competitor (or buffer) in a 50 uL volume was added in the preliminary competition when 100x and 500x competitor were evaluated, only 0.8 nM [3H]17beta-estradiol was used. The plate was incubated at room temperature for 2.5 h. At the end of this incubation period 150 uL of ice-cold dextran coated charcoal (5% activated charcoal coated with 0.05% 69K dextran) was added to each well and the plate was immediately centrifuged at 99 g for 5 minutes at 4 C. 200 uL of the supernatant solution was then removed for scintillation counting. Samples were counted to 2% or 10 minutes, whichever occurs first.
